build.notes: App compilation and packaging succeeded, NOT technical tests. APK exact SHA and size independently verified against actual GitHub uploaded artifact. Source SHA records marker commit; subsequent documentation commits NOT included in compiled APK. Production diagnostics mode NoOp, P04 approvals false, #80/#82 open, no real Beta metrics.

technical_test_inventory.note: Source-method count from GitHub files, NOT number of executed tests; individual tests must be authorized/actually run and checked at P14.

pending_risks.evidence: No standalone short history DAO or retention policy

acceptance_criteria.description: Required events from one authoritative source; no duplicates on recreation/retry
Allowed properties match eight-event telemetry table and enums/buckets
Crash reports only safe non-sensitive diagnostic context
Analytics and crash disabled or safe local/non-prod configuration
User can clear local history and diagnostics through approved Settings flow
Microphone and diagnostic collection explained clearly
Separate Cloud STT consent and destination/retention disclosure before any use
Schema tests reject invalid and prohibited fields/values
Evidence sufficiently complete for human Go / Iterate / Stop
